messages: Good morning Rohan! How's your Sunday starting?
lazy. had idli for breakfast, mom made sambar also
Idli with sambar on a Sunday sounds perfect. Any plans today?
got a call from Zoho HR yesterday. interview on 8th for software developer trainee role
Rohan, that's big! Zoho in Chennai? How are you feeling about it?
yes Chennai office. nervous but excited. my friend Arjun said just do leetcode easy and medium problems daily
Arjun's advice is solid. Small daily practice beats cramming. Which topics worry you most?
arrays and strings mostly. also they said there will be a round on basic DBMS
Then maybe two easy problems a day plus one DBMS topic. Doable in 3 days.
ok will do that. tonight rewatching Leo with friends, need some break also
Good, a break helps the brain. Enjoy the movie!
Today is the big day! How did you sleep?
barely 4 hrs. interview is at 3pm at Zoho, technical round first
4 hours is okay, adrenaline will carry you. Have you eaten?
no. will have dosa at the hostel mess later
Please eat properly before 3pm. Empty stomach makes nerves worse.
revising pointers and joins now. its raining so heavy here
Rain and revision, cozy at least. Leave early for the office, traffic will be bad.
auto booked for 1pm. wearing the blue shirt mom ironed
Blue shirt is a lucky choice. Breathe slowly, you know this stuff.
All the best Rohan! Message me after.
You must be. Eat something and rest. Want to talk about it?
had biryani for dinner, roommate treated me
Biryani after a long day is well deserved.
Good way to switch off. Sleep early tonight.
Hey Rohan! How is the weekend going?
still waiting for the result. HR said they will mail by 20th
Waiting is the hardest part. Try keeping yourself busy.
yeah. cleaning my room today, so much dust
A clean room feels like a fresh start. Put on some music!
playing Anirudh songs only. its the weather also, so cloudy
Anirudh and clouds, perfect mood. Any lunch plan?
pongal and vada from the canteen
Sounds good. Ping me when you take a break.
got the mail from Zoho. i am selected! offer letter attached, 6.5 LPA
ROHAN! Congratulations, that's amazing! All that prep paid off.
i called mom and she started crying lol. dad said treat for everyone
That's so sweet. Where will you take everyone for the treat?
some biryani place near home, maybe saturday
You deserve a big biryani. Also tell Arjun thanks for the leetcode tip.
haha yes will do. joining date is december
Perfect, two months to relax and prepare. Proud of you.
Hi Rohan! What did you do today?
just slept and ate lol. mom made fish fry
That's a proper holiday. Was the fish fry good?
super. also started watching a new series on hotstar
some crime thing, too many twists. will tell you if its good
Please do. I like a good twist.

probes.expect: Understands this refers to the Zoho interview earlier that day and responds supportively about it, not asking what went okay

probes.ask: which company did i interview with again?
what happened with that interview in the end?
probes.expect: Says Rohan was selected and got an offer from Zoho

probes.ask: which city is that office in? i forgot
which friend gave me prep advice?

probes.expect: Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no name
